subject: Private deployment traffic contracts acceptance & NOC handoff
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@greenwave.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Eng Team <eng@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Traffic contracts and evidence for private VPC handoff

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the runthrough on Friday. We have one gating ask from our network & security team before we can schedule the NOC handoff: an explicit list of ingress/egress traffic contracts (ports, CIDR ranges, expected protocols) and a short reference diagram that maps those flows to the control-plane/data-plane demarc you presented.

Specific asks: 
- A single-slide reference diagram that shows ingress points, egress destinations, and the control/data demarc (PDF ok).
- A spreadsheet with per-route acceptance criteria: source CIDR, dest CIDR, ports/protocols, expected bandwidth, and fallback behavior.
- Any evidence-of-test (pcap snippets, curl checks) you can provide that shows the control plane auth handshake and a successful host-to-runtime data flow.

We need this by EOD Wednesday (our PDT) to keep the planned 7/1 cutover. If it's easier, attach the files and we can validate on our side.

Sanjay
Network Lead, Greenwave Systems

---
Note: attachment references below when Vanessa replies will be links to your artifacts; we won't need full binary captures in email.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@greenwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Traffic contracts and evidence for private VPC handoff

Sanjay — thanks for the clear list. Attaching the two artifacts you asked for and a short checklist for acceptance tests. High level notes first: 

- Diagram: vpc-attachment-wiring-v2.pdf (one-page) shows control plane endpoints, data-plane clusters, and the recommended egress CIDRs for telemetry & KMS.
- Spreadsheet: traffic-contracts-v1.xlsx contains per-route rules, ports, and expected RPS/bandwidth. We added a "fallback" column that specifies the behavior if a route is rate-limited or blackholed.
- Evidence: we ran short smoke tests from the tenant runtime -> runtime (data plane) and control plane handshake logs; we captured minimal pcap snippets and included pass/fail notes in the spreadsheet. We won't email raw pcaps; instead the Drive link below has the sanitized captures.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-example
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/GW-4578

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm Greenwave's network team can accept the listed egress CIDRs for telemetry and KMS.
2) Confirm that the acceptance spreadsheet covers the testers' success criteria (we used your template fields).
3) If accepted, we propose the NOC handoff on 2026-06-30 10:00 PDT (we'll provision an 90-minute window).

Attachments: vpc-attachment-wiring-v2.pdf, traffic-contracts-v1.xlsx

Thanks — Vanessa
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Traffic contracts and evidence for private VPC handoff (internal)

Folks — quick internal alignment before I send the acceptance confirmation to Greenwave: 

- I reviewed the spreadsheet. A couple of gaps: the "expected bandwidth" column is rounded (we should add peak short-burst numbers for their perf team) and we should call out the TCP vs UDP behavior on the rate-limited fallback.
- Jonas: can you add a short note in the diagram callout that the control plane TLS termination is restricted to the mgmt CIDR and that any cross-tenant telemetry egress goes via the telemetry CIDR only?
- Kimberly: can you confirm whether our KMS endpoints will be pinned to the listed IPs or to the gateway FQDN (they asked for IPs in the sheet). If pinned to FQDN, we need to provide a certificate rotation note.

I'll draft a short cover email with links and a summary acceptance statement once the two items above are updated. Can we close this by EOD Tuesday? I can be async on Wednesday morning if needed.

Thanks,
Neha
Manager, Private Deployments, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Traffic contracts and evidence for private VPC handoff (internal)

Neha — will update the diagram with the explicit control-plane TLS termination callout and add peak burst numbers to the spreadsheet.

Also: for the "evidence-of-test" item, instead of full pcaps we have a sanitized pcap snippet in Drive and a curl + openssl s_client snippet that demonstrates the handshake. I'll add the commands under an "How we tested" tab in the sheet.

I'll push the updated artifacts to the Drive and ping Sanjay when done.

-Jonas
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@greenwave.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Eng Team <eng@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Traffic contracts and evidence for private VPC handoff

Vanessa / Neha — thank you, this is great. We reviewed the updated spreadsheet and diagram this afternoon. A couple of final, minor asks before we mark acceptance: 

- Confirm the KMS endpoint: IP pinning is acceptable for the initial cutover; we will require a signed note about rotation cadence if you move to FQDN later.
- We want the NOC handoff window to include a short alarm-sensitivity review; can Redwood ops be ready to sit with our on-call for 30 minutes post-cutover to validate telemetry?

If you confirm both items we can sign off and keep the 2026-06-30 10:00 PDT NOC handoff.

Sanjay
Network Lead, Greenwave Systems
